title: Here’s How to Watch ‘Darius Rucker: They Called Me Hootie’ Online for Free

contentText:

Singer-songwriter and Grammy Award-winner Darius Rucker will always be considered “Hootie” from Hootie and the Blowfish, even though he never went by that name. In fact, there was even an iconic Key & Peele sketch about the confusion about the alt-rock band’s name.

Watch on Disney+ with Hulu

But for better or worse, Darius Rucker is Hootie, despite also having a successful solo career in country music and R&B. And now, a new documentary explores the life and career of Rucker, featuring new interviews with Woody Harrelson, Brad Paisley, Lady A and others.

Starting on Monday (Nov. 16), Darius Rucker: They Called Me Hootie is available to stream with Disney+ with Hulu .
